Students Using Quirks Off Campus.text: When a hero student uses a Quirk off campus without a license, the student is treated as any other citizen, and the academy hears about it too. Hero academy enrollment grants no legal authority: a student who fights a villain, chases a suspect or shows off a Quirk in town faces the same police statement, warning, fine or charge as anyone else, and the police inform the academy. At U.A. Academy the homeroom teacher deals with it next. Penalties range from a reprimand and house arrest in the dorms with cleaning duty to suspension, and teachers can expel a student whose judgment they no longer trust. A real emergency softens the outcome without erasing it. Students with a provisional license may use their Quirks in emergencies and under a supervising pro, but the license does not cover patrols, personal fights or showing off, and misuse can cost the license itself. Using a Quirk on campus under a teacher's supervision remains the normal place to train.
